esg_reason: 주주가 기후 변화 관련 목표 달성을 위한 추가적인 정보 공개를 요구하고 있기 때문에 E로 분류됨.

holder_request.summary: 주주들은 Alphabet이 기후 변화 관련 약속을 어떻게 이행할 것인지에 대한 보고서를 발행할 것을 요구하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Resolved: Shareholders request that Alphabet publish a report, at reasonable cost, within a reasonable time, and excluding confidential or proprietary information, explaining how it will meet the climate change-related commitments it has made on GHGs.

company_response.summary: 회사는 기존의 환경 보고서가 기후 계획과 진행 상황에 대한 충분한 정보를 제공하고 있다고 주장하며, 추가 보고서는 불필요하다고 반대하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Our existing environmental reporting has long provided detailed and extensive information about our climate plans, progress, policies, and practices.
Preparing the separate, bespoke report as requested by the proponent would be duplicative and inefficient, administratively burdensome, and an ineffective use of our resources.

key_issues.issue: 기후 목표 달성을 위한 추가 정보 공개의 필요성

evidence.quote: investors remain in the dark about the full scope, scale, and timelines of these projects and thus, the likelihood of Alphabet meeting its 2030 goals.
we are also open about the challenges that we face, including slower-than-needed deployment of carbon-free energy technologies at scale.
Climate change-driven impacts could erase trillions in global GDP by 2050, posing macroeconomic risks that may substantively depress returns for long-term diversified investors.
This extensive reporting allows our shareholders to understand our annual performance, including our emissions by scope.

vote_opinion.reason: 주주들은 Alphabet이 기후 변화 목표를 달성하기 위한 구체적인 계획과 진행 상황에 대한 투명성을 요구하고 있으며, 이는 장기적인 주주 가치를 보호하는 데 중요하다.

evidence.quote: By providing additional transparency on its decarbonization planning, Alphabet could assure investors that it is prepared to meet its climate goals.
